name: silent_ema_v26428
notes: Silent network of 2026-11-12: the learner's EMA copy (decay 0.999 per version) at v26,428. Training resumed on 2026-11-11 from the EMA weights of v24,721 with gradient accumulation x2 (Silent DR #17) and ran to v26,428 (DR #17-#21). In a second snapshot-ensemble test neither an 8-snapshot ensemble of raw weights nor one of EMA weights beat this single network, so there was again no distillation (Silent DR #22). Bit-identical to the network the 1,000-seed tests used.
eval: 71.2% greedy on 1,000 W1 seeds (A10), +5.0 +/- 3.3 pp over silent_ema_v24721 on the same seeds (paired, p = 0.004); 74.0% (95% CI about 71.3-76.7%) with Act-3 double-boss PIMC search on the same seeds, +2.7 pp over its greedy trunk (McNemar exact p = 0.0018) and +4.5 +/- 3.2 pp over silent_ema_v24721 with search (p = 0.006)

name: silent_raw_v26428
notes: Silent learner (raw) weights at v26,428 (from scratch since 2026-11-09; Muon on the hidden 2-D weights and Adam elsewhere; observation format 23 from v19,901; restarted from the v24,721 EMA weights with gradient accumulation x2 at DR #17; skipping easy fights with skip probability 0.8). The network routine evaluation measures and the trunk the combat-outcome heads read.
eval: 66.4% greedy on the same 1,000 W1 seeds (EMA vs raw +4.8 +/- 3.3 pp, p = 0.006; 8-snapshot ensembles 68.7% raw, 69.5% EMA); routine evaluation 65.7% over the last 12 rounds v26,215-v26,428 (3,027/4,608; 384 P1 seeds per round, raw weights, greedy, A10)

name: silent_combat_outcome_heads_v26428

calibration.definition: mean of (actual HP after the fight / max HP at the start) minus the raw HP head's predicted mean, on eligible fights that were played; keys act<n>_<room>

notes: Combat-outcome heads of the Silent at v26,428 (sts2rl.model.CombatOutcomeHeads): 41-bin distribution of HP after a won fight (fraction of max HP at the start) and per-potion use probability. They read the detached trunk embedding g of silent_raw_v26428.pt; used in training to sample outcomes of skipped fights (Silent DR #14). Calibration window v25,485-v26,428 is the stretch under the final configuration (skip probability 0.8, DR #21).
eval: played eligible fights v25,485-v26,428: HP residual -0.0043 to +0.0053 of max HP per (act, room); potion use 0.192 predicted vs 0.190 actual (731,183 potion-fights)
